name: core-variants
description: Variants, the core's field typed by another field's value (D16, amended): while kind holds a value the config lists, result is held to that type as strictly as a field of it, unknown keys refused at every depth; while kind holds another value or none, result holds none. The config is held to the type and the document; a new version keeps each value's type and may give a new value one; the types it checks are held to the compatibility rule; the describe document and the create and update tools show each variant, as JSON Schema a validator agrees with.

s1.name: Step
s1.description: A step an engine runs with the core's Constants and Variants and no extension: its kind is set at create and never changes, and its result has the shape its kind gives it, a VerifyResult for a verify step and a ReviewResult for a review, and none for a note.

s11.useWhen: Use to create a new Step: data holds its own fields, and id names it, or the engine makes one. Give kind at create: it does not change after it, and one left absent stays absent. Give result the shape kind picks: result holds ReviewResult when kind is review or VerifyResult when kind is verify, and nothing while kind holds another value or none.
s11.doNotUseWhen: Do not use to change one that exists; call update.
s11.success: Returns the new instance with its id, its seq, its own fields in data and its behaviors' fields in behaviors, by behavior name.

limit.description: How many instances a page holds, 50 when absent

valueRefs.description: Return each field the value store holds as its ref, { "$value": <hash>, "bytes": <n> }, listed in valueRefs, rather than its value, which get_value reads

where.description: The values the instances hold, by field: a value, null for none, or a list of 1 to 100 meaning any of them; every member must hold

s13.useWhen: Use to page through Step instances, oldest first. where keeps the ones whose fields hold the values it gives, null meaning no value and a list of values any of them: title or kind; a behavior's field by its qualified name, the behavior's, a dot and the field's.
s13.doNotUseWhen: Do not use to read one instance whose id you have; call get.
s13.success: Returns items and next; pass next as cursor for the page after, until it is null. With where, a page can hold fewer items than limit, even none, while next is not null: read on until it is.

expectedSeq.description: The sequence the caller last read (an instance's seq): the call is refused unless the instance is still at it

allOf.description: While kind is "review", result is a ReviewResult
While kind is "verify", result is a VerifyResult
While kind holds another value or none, result holds none

patch.description: A JSON merge patch of the Step

result.description: Any valid JSON value: object, array, primitive, or null

s15.useWhen: Use to change the own fields of the Step with the id, as a JSON merge patch; with expectedSeq, the update is refused if the instance changed since that seq. A patch of result keeps the shape kind picks, as merged; the describe document shows each shape under allOf.
s15.doNotUseWhen: Do not use to set a behavior's field: the patch holds own fields only, and a behavior's fields change only through its operations. Do not change kind: a change is refused as invalid_instance, with rule constant at the field.
s15.success: Returns the instance as the patch left it, with its next seq.

s16.useWhen: Use to make a namespace for a new project: it starts with no schemas of its own and looks schema names up in the shared namespace after itself.
s16.doNotUseWhen: Do not use to make a schema; call define_schema in the namespace. Do not use for a name that is a namespace already, archived or not: the create is refused (conflict).
s16.success: Returns the namespace, active, with who made it and when.

s17.useWhen: Use when a project made with create_namespace is finished: its schemas, instances and events stay readable, every write is refused (namespace_archived), and its reactions and schedules stop.
s17.doNotUseWhen: Do not use on a namespace the engine's options configure, which is refused (conflict), or to remove data: nothing is removed.
s17.success: Returns the namespace, archived, with who archived it and when; archiving an archived namespace changes nothing.

scenarios.name: Variants (node) > the describe document and the create and update tools show each variant: an if/then per value of kind and one for every other value

expect.name: Step
expect.description: A step an engine runs with the core's Constants and Variants and no extension: its kind is set at create and never changes, and its result has the shape its kind gives it, a VerifyResult for a verify step and a ReviewResult for a review, and none for a note.

result.description: Any valid JSON value: object, array, primitive, or null

allOf.description: While kind is "review", result is a ReviewResult
While kind is "verify", result is a VerifyResult
While kind holds another value or none, result holds none

instanceBehaviors.description: The instance's behaviors' fields, by behavior name, apart from its own fields

behaviors.name: Constants
behaviors.description: Fields of the type that its create sets and nothing changes after: an update that changes one, a caller's or one a behavior's operation applies, is refused at the field, unless the caller holds the config's permission. A field the create leaves absent stays absent. What routes an instance, such as a step's kind or the key a blueprint stamped it with, stays what its create gave it.
behaviors.summary: kind keeps the value the create of each Step gives; after it, nothing changes it.

behaviors.name: Variants
behaviors.description: Types an open JSON field of the type by the value of another of its fields: while by holds a value types lists, field, when it holds a value, is held to that type of the schema document as a field of the type is, unknown keys refused at every depth; while by holds another value or none, field holds none. A result whose shape differs per kind of step is refused when it is written in the wrong shape. The describe document and the create and update tools show each variant.
behaviors.summary: On each Step, result takes the shape kind picks: result holds ReviewResult when kind is review or VerifyResult when kind is verify, and nothing while kind holds another value or none.

operations.name: create
operations.title: Create Step
operations.description: Creates a Step: validates the instance, data, against the schema's live version and stores it under id, or under a new id when none is given.

operations.name: get
operations.title: Get Step
operations.description: Returns the Step with the id: its own fields in data, its behaviors' in behaviors.

valueRefs.description: Return each field the value store holds as its ref, { "$value": <hash>, "bytes": <n> }, listed in valueRefs, rather than its value, which get_value reads

guidance.useWhen: Use when you have the id of the Step to read.
guidance.doNotUseWhen: Do not use to find Step instances; call list.
guidance.success: Returns the instance with its seq, its own fields in data and its behaviors' fields in behaviors, by behavior name.

operations.name: list
operations.title: List Step
operations.description: Lists Step instances in creation order, a page at a time: pass a page's next as cursor for the page after it. where keeps the instances whose fields hold the values it gives, a list meaning any of them; a filtered page can hold fewer than limit while next is not null.

next.description: The next page's cursor; null after the last page

operations.name: update
operations.title: Update Step
operations.description: Applies a JSON merge patch (RFC 7386) to the Step with the id: a member replaces the instance's, a nested object merges and null removes a member. With expectedSeq the update is refused unless the instance is still at that sequence.

operations.name: delete
operations.title: Delete Step
operations.description: Deletes the Step with the id. With expectedSeq the delete is refused unless the instance is still at that sequence.

expectedSeq.description: The sequence the caller last read (an instance's seq): the call is refused unless the instance is still at it

guidance.useWhen: Use to delete the Step with the id for good; with expectedSeq, the delete is refused if the instance changed since that seq.
guidance.success: Returns null; the instance and what its behaviors kept for it are gone.

tools.name: step.update
tools.title: Update Step

mcp.name: Update Step
mcp.description: Applies a JSON merge patch (RFC 7386) to the Step with the id: a member replaces the instance's, a nested object merges and null removes a member. With expectedSeq the update is refused unless the instance is still at that sequence.

tools.name: step.delete
tools.title: Delete Step

mcp.name: Delete Step
mcp.description: Deletes the Step with the id. With expectedSeq the delete is refused unless the instance is still at that sequence.

superschematic/operation-guidance.useWhen: Use to delete the Step with the id for good; with expectedSeq, the delete is refused if the instance changed since that seq.
superschematic/operation-guidance.success: Returns null; the instance and what its behaviors kept for it are gone.
